create_mlp_epinet: create an MLP EpiNet with specified output sizes, hidden layers, and index dimension using make_mlp_epinet
build_epinet_with_prior_scale: build an MLP EpiNet with a custom prior_scale factor to weight the prior network output
create_epinet_stop_gradient: create an MLP EpiNet that stops gradient flow from the base network to the epitaxial network
build_epinet_exposed_layers: build an MLP EpiNet with exposed intermediate layer features via the expose_layers parameter
review_make_mlp_epinet: review the make_mlp_epinet factory function that combines ExposedMLP and ProjectedMLP into an EnnArray
